info.title: InfraPulse MSK
info.description:
API InfraPulse MSK. Документация открыта для чтения; каждый маршрут, кроме `/health/*` и входа, проверяет сессию или токен интеграции.

* **Чтение (GET)** — по cookie сессии: войти в веб-интерфейс этого же сайта, затем «Try it out» здесь.
* **Пачки наблюдений** `POST /api/v1/observations` — токен интеграции: «Authorize» → `integrationToken`, значение `ipk_...` без слова Bearer.
* **Запись под сессией (POST)** — дополнительно `csrfToken`: значение cookie `__Host-infrapulse-csrf`.

Инструкция для систем-источников — `docs/INTEGRATION_API.md` в репозитории.

get.description:
Журнал прогнозов: снимок карточки, исход по данным на `as_of` и последнее решение
и результат проверки, сохранённые к `records_as_of` (по часам сервера, даже если
позже данных). Без `as_of` — текущий журнал; с `as_of` решения тоже не позже него.
Dispatcher counters: выдано / снята по событию / без события / неизвестно / открыто.

requestBody.description: ObservationBatch as JSON, or the same batch in XML: root <batch> with the batch_id attribute (or a <batch_id> element) and <record> elements whose child elements are the record fields; alarm is true or false. DTD and entities are refused (422 xml_forbidden). docs/INTEGRATION_API.md

415.description: Content-Type is not JSON or XML

get.description:
«Сейчас» (F-04): source alarms (``alarm=true``) with event time from
``event_from`` — counts over the whole window, objects and the latest ``limit``
records by event time, newest first. The source flag is not a confirmed failure.

BucketRate.title: BucketRate
BucketRate.description: Share of cards with an event in the rank bucket over one past period.

Capabilities.title: Capabilities
Capabilities.description:
What the running stand serves, read from its configuration and database.

``stage``: ``scaffold`` (no data source), ``fixture`` (synthetic data), ``not_ready``
(replay/received scope not loaded or database unavailable), ``observations_only``
(source records loaded, no forecast published yet), ``forecast_published`` (the
worker published a forecast for the scope). ``inference_ready`` is true exactly for
``forecast_published``: forecasts are computed by the worker and read by the API;
the API never trains or scores a model inside a request.

ChannelAttentionSummary.title: ChannelAttentionSummary
ChannelAttentionSummary.description: A channel's latest received record, not an inferred current state.

enum: Линии питания освещения, вентиляции и насосов: сначала потеря связи („Неисправен“), через ~10 мин — „Обесточен“. Причина неизвестна
потеря связи дымового или теплового извещателя либо серия неподтверждённых самосбросов вне сессии ТО; причина неизвестна
event_label.title: Event Label

ForecastCard.title: ForecastCard
ForecastCard.description:
Immutable object x sensor type card as issued at ``issued_at`` (the cutoff).

Later observations are never written into the card; see ``ForecastCardView``.

ForecastCardView.title: ForecastCardView
ForecastCardView.description:
Issued card plus a view-time «уже наблюдается» overlay.

The overlay is a current observation after issue, shown separately; the card
and its score are not recomputed. The journal stores only the bare card.

ForecastChannel.title: ForecastChannel

ForecastCheckResult.title: ForecastCheckResult
ForecastCheckResult.description: Stored check result revision of a card (append-only, audited).

ForecastCheckResultCreate.title: ForecastCheckResultCreate

ForecastCheckResultList.title: ForecastCheckResultList
ForecastCheckResultList.description: Every check result revision of one card, newest first.

ForecastDecisionCreate.title: ForecastDecisionCreate
ForecastDecisionCreate.description:
Dispatcher decision request; the author comes from the session, never the body.

``idempotency_key`` repeats return the stored decision; ``expected_revision`` is the
card's decision revision the dispatcher saw (0 when none), a mismatch is 409.

ForecastDecisionList.title: ForecastDecisionList
ForecastDecisionList.description: Every decision revision of one card, newest first, with its author.

ForecastDecisionSummary.title: ForecastDecisionSummary
ForecastDecisionSummary.description: Dispatcher decision (technologist dictionary R1–R7) and later check result (O1–O6).

ForecastFact.title: ForecastFact
ForecastFact.description: An observed fact with its period before the cutoff; never a causal diagnosis.

ForecastJournalCounts.title: ForecastJournalCounts
ForecastJournalCounts.description: Journal counters for dispatchers; quality ratios live on the research side.

ForecastJournalCountsRow.title: ForecastJournalCountsRow
ForecastJournalCountsRow.description:
Dispatcher journal counters for one period x target x horizon; no P or R here.

выдано = снята по событию + без события + неизвестно + открыто.

ForecastJournalEntry.title: ForecastJournalEntry
ForecastJournalEntry.description:
Append-only journal row: the issued card snapshot, its outcome and a decision.

For a rolling list with release the card leaves the list at its first event
(``released_at``) and is realized then; otherwise the outcome resolves only after
the window ends.

ForecastJournalList.title: ForecastJournalList
ForecastJournalList.description:
Append-only journal page pinned by ``journal_watermark`` (committed entries).

Two time axes. ``as_of`` is the data moment: cards, outcomes and window events are
shown as known from the data up to it. Decisions and check results are records on
the wall clock (when a dispatcher saved them): an entry carries the newest one saved
by ``records_as_of``, even when it is later than ``as_of`` — on a historical scope
(data ended in the past) every decision is taken after the data. ``None`` (fixture)
bounds them by ``as_of``. Outcomes and quality metrics never depend on them.

ForecastList.title: ForecastList
ForecastList.description:
Current cards of every published target x horizon run.

``publication_token`` is opaque and covers all ``runs``; a cursor issued under
another token is stale (409), so pages never mix publications.

ForecastOutcome.title: ForecastOutcome
ForecastOutcome.description:
Registered event after the window by the same label definition, not a human verdict.

Abstained cards get ``event_without_forecast`` / ``no_event_without_forecast``
for coverage accounting and are always excluded from quality metrics.

ForecastQualityRow.title: ForecastQualityRow
ForecastQualityRow.description:
«Прогноз против факта» for one period x target x horizon.

Card counts are the «k из n» basis: k = ``cards_realized``, n = realized + not
realized; pending and unknown cards are counted but excluded from the share.
Abstained cards are not issued and are not counted here.

ForecastQualitySummary.title: ForecastQualitySummary
ForecastQualitySummary.description: Weekly summary of the journal; ``evidence_scope`` says what it may be used for.

ForecastRecommendation.title: ForecastRecommendation
ForecastRecommendation.description:
Recommended action from a versioned policy (technologist dictionary R1–R7).

The text is computed on the server from facts and the policy; the UI never derives
it. It is highlighted, not pre-selected, in the decision form.

ForecastScore.title: ForecastScore
ForecastScore.description:
Card score at issue.

- ``risk_estimate`` (gate A): calibrated value labelled «оценка риска» beside the
  empirical rates of its ``rank_bucket``; the value need not equal those rates.
- ``frequency_share`` (static list): ``value`` equals the share of its
  ``frequency`` bucket, shown as «k из n» with the Wilson interval.
- ``probability``: only after ML-05 approval (see the card validator).

``rank`` is the order of checking at the issue cutoff among ``ranked_cards``
candidates, not severity. For a rolling list ``card_budget`` is the maximum number
of open cards of the run.

ForecastState.title: ForecastState
ForecastState.description:
Cheap polling document (UI-03): refetch lists only when ``generation`` changes.

``data_as_of`` is the data watermark of the latest published run; the UI shows the
forecast as of it, not as of the wall clock (historical and uploaded data).

ForecastWindowEvent.title: ForecastWindowEvent
ForecastWindowEvent.description:
A registered event of the card's pair inside the card window.

``while_open`` tells whether the card was open at the event start. Recall variants
are computed from these rows by a versioned definition, not fixed in the contract.

FrequencyBucket.title: FrequencyBucket
FrequencyBucket.description:
«k из n»: share of past cards with an event among cards whose pair had a
number of events in the past 365 days within ``[events_from, events_to]``.

Built on a stated past period (``table_version``); it is a frequency of the
history, not a calibrated probability (ML-05). The Wilson interval is shown with it.

ImportFile.title: ImportFile
ImportFile.description:
One uploaded file and its processing report.

Row counts: ``rows_total = rows_accepted + rows_duplicate + rows_quarantined``.
``unknown_channels`` are channels absent from the reference; their rows are kept
with an unknown object (DATA-04). ``forecast_generation`` is the publication that
first included the file.

ListPolicy.title: ListPolicy
ListPolicy.description:
How cards of a run are issued.

- ``daily_top_k``: the run's own top ``max_open`` cards; cards of older runs are gone.
- ``rolling_release``: a card stays open ``window_days`` from its cutoff, each cutoff
  adds cards by score for pairs without an open card until ``max_open`` are open,
  nothing is displaced; with ``release_on = first_event`` the card leaves at its
  first registered event and frees its place from the next cutoff.

NotificationMember.title: NotificationMember
NotificationMember.description:
One source record of a bell row; open it with ``/api/v1/attention?row_uid=``.

``channel_name`` — the channel name from the channel layout (the active reference), as
``/attention`` shows it; none when the channel is not in the reference (QA 29.09, D3).

NotificationSummary.title: NotificationSummary
NotificationSummary.description: Counts and the newest items after ``since`` up to ``as_of`` (the data watermark).

ObjectScheme.description: Picket line of one object at ``as_of``.

convention.default: условная шкала пикетов из названий каналов, 10 м на пикет; не план

ObjectSchemeSummary.title: ObjectSchemeSummary
ObjectSchemeSummary.description: One row of the scheme overview: the object's picket span and what is on it.

ObservationBatch.title: ObservationBatch
ObservationBatch.description:
A batch of records from an integration; ``batch_id`` is the client's idempotency key.

The same ``batch_id`` with the same bytes returns the stored import; with other bytes
it is a conflict (409). Records are also deduplicated with the CSV import key.
The body is JSON or the same batch in XML (``<batch batch_id="...">`` with
``<record>`` elements whose child elements are these fields); both are validated
by this model.

ObservationRecord.title: ObservationRecord
ObservationRecord.description:
One journal record with the fields of the CSV export.

Keys may be given in English or as in the CSV header: ``event_id`` / ``ид_события``,
``channel_id`` / ``ид_канала_данных``, ``alarm`` / ``тревожное``, ``value`` /
``значение_датчика``. Time is either ``date`` + ``time`` (local Moscow time, the same
rule as the CSV: ``дата`` ``YYYY-MM-DD`` and ``время`` ``HH:MM:SS``) or ``event_at``
(ISO 8601 with an offset), never both. ``value`` is the source text kept verbatim.

ObservedOverlay.title: ObservedOverlay
ObservedOverlay.description: Current observation after issue, shown separately. The forecast is not recomputed.

ObservedOverlayItem.title: ObservedOverlayItem
ObservedOverlayItem.description: Source record seen after issue; raw text and the original alarm are kept apart.

PublishedRun.title: PublishedRun
PublishedRun.description: Currently published run of one target x horizon with its own generation counter.

QuarantineSample.title: QuarantineSample
QuarantineSample.description: A rejected line with its reason; the raw excerpt is shown only to administrators.

RankBucket.title: RankBucket
RankBucket.description:
Card's bucket under a versioned per target x horizon policy, e.g. daily
``[1, 6, 11, 51]`` (1–5, 6–10, 11–50, 51+) or weekly ``[1, 11, 21, 51]``.
The policy also assigns the risk level of every bucket.

RatioMetric.title: RatioMetric
RatioMetric.description:
Named ratio with its numerator, denominator and definition version.

The name is free (e.g. a recall variant chosen later); the contract fixes only
that every shown ratio carries its counts.

RecurringPlace.title: RecurringPlace
RecurringPlace.description: Registry row «хронически проблемное место»: frequent past events, not a forecast.

ReplayCoverageObject.title: ReplayCoverageObject
ReplayCoverageObject.description: Reference channels heard within this bounded replay window.

ReportCardCounts.title: ReportCardCounts
ReportCardCounts.description: выдано = снята по событию + без события + неизвестно + открыто.

ResearchBlock.title: ResearchBlock
ResearchBlock.description:
A read-only titled table (e.g. a registry proposed by DS); nothing is hard-coded.

Blocks are optional and appear only when the served summary contains them.

SchemeAlarm.title: SchemeAlarm
SchemeAlarm.description:
A source record with the original ``alarm=true`` within 24 h before ``as_of``; not a
forecast. F6 (B-3): ``cleared_at`` is the first later «Норма» of the same channel without
the alarm flag, not later than ``as_of`` — after it the line is no longer in alarm;
``None`` — no such record yet: the alarm record may still be in force.

SchemeFeeder.title: SchemeFeeder
SchemeFeeder.description:
A power line of the object («линия электропитания»; the model name keeps «feeder»)
with its picket and past episodes; facts about the past only.

SchemeLandmark.title: SchemeLandmark
SchemeLandmark.description: Panel element used as an orientation mark (input, ATS, switchboard).

SchemeNamedLink.title: SchemeNamedLink
SchemeNamedLink.description:
A link named in the channel name, e.g. «ФВ2 (В23)» → «В23», «ФРО1 (ГРО1-6)» →
«ГРО1-6» (C0.3). A label only: no topology and no connection is inferred from it.

SourceAlarmObject.title: SourceAlarmObject
SourceAlarmObject.description:
One object of the «Сейчас» window (F-04): every source alarm record of the window.

``scheme_record_count`` — records on the power lines drawn on the object's scheme
(feeders of the channel layout); the scheme counts only these, the window every sensor.
``last_message`` — the latest record by event time, not by receipt.

SourceAlarmWindow.title: SourceAlarmWindow
SourceAlarmWindow.description:
«Сейчас» (F-04): records with the source flag «тревожное» (``alarm=true``) whose event
time is at or after ``event_from``, available at ``as_of``.

Counts cover the whole window. ``objects`` and ``latest`` are ordered by event time,
newest first; ``objects`` holds up to the requested number of objects, ``object_count``
all of them. A source alarm is the source flag, not a confirmed failure.

integrationToken.description: Токен интеграции внешней системы (выдаёт администратор сервиса). Даёт только право ingest: отправку пачек и статус своих пачек.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-infrapulse-session
sessionCookie.description: Сессия входа через каталог. Ставится при входе в веб-интерфейс этого же сайта и отправляется браузером сама; поле в «Authorize» заполнять не нужно.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Для POST под сессией: значение cookie __Host-infrapulse-csrf. С токеном интеграции не нужен.
